name: zclass_node_set_pickup_flags_recursive
description: zClass_Node::SetPickupFlagsRecursive restores pickup-specific active/raycast flags on a node and every child in its listB tree.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the Pickup runtime source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja reconstruction for 0x41cef0 identifies the recursive listB walk, clears flag bit 0x08, ORs 0x40010 into each visited node, and returns 1; the native pickup leaf smoke verifies root and child flag restoration while preserving unrelated bits.
